verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI as a single-session interactive/scriptable coding assistant with non-interactive scripting mode, but no documented capability for orchestrating fleets of autonomous agents running in parallel for hours/days; the lone mention of a 'subagent system' (gemini-cli-comm-9) is a dismissive aside, not evidence of a fleet-management feature. Community reports even describe agent loops getting stuck or failing (gemini-cli-comm-10, gemini-cli-comm-11), undermining any claim of reliable long-running autonomous parallel operation.
